entries.notes: All four TypeScript assertions are translated. The Rust API skeleton intentionally panics until the implementation phase begins.
All three route assertions are translated, including configured base paths and rejection of the retired standalone step route.
All ten environment-resolution assertions are translated with explicit maps rather than process-global mutation.
All 35 parsing, formatting, default-export, nested-function, sanitized-name, and fallback assertions are translated.

All nine sharing, versioning, mutation, lookup, and reset assertions are represented against the planned process registry. Final GREEN additionally requires a JavaScript binding test proving globalThis and duplicated-module behavior.
All five one-shot resolver and lazy memoization assertions are represented. Final GREEN additionally requires the JavaScript binding to expose native Promise behavior.
All three crate-root export assertions are translated and intentionally depend on the still-RED parse-name contract.
All six selector and sink assertions are translated with an injected five-level log sink so disabled logging can be proven silent.
All 23 search-order, parent-walk, path-normalization, tilde, short-name, and missing-directory assertions are translated with isolated temporary directories and injected cwd/home paths.
All 20 listener enumeration, deterministic ordering, restart, concurrency, workflow-health probing, timeout, IPv6, and Windows netstat assertions are translated.
All 19 package-discovery and static-analysis assertions are translated, including cross-file empty collections, static fields, this resolution, .mts sources, and per-copy annotations.

All nine TypeScript assertions are mirrored against the existing Rust time implementation. Status remains partial until the new direct mirror test passes the branch workflow; differential coverage already exists separately.
All five declared logging cases are translated, including default silence, exact and wildcard DEBUG matching, explicit negation, and repeated Next-like compile summaries.
The workspace-root precedence case is translated with a real temporary filesystem tree containing both pnpm-workspace.yaml and an app-local package-lock.json.

Both regular and symlinked tsconfig behaviors are translated even though the inventory parser counts only the direct it() declaration. Final GREEN must also run the symlink fixture through real esbuild resolution.
All three serde-only import, identical pnpm peer-copy deduplication, and divergent-copy collision declarations are translated.

The CJS __dirname/__filename regression is translated with explicit counts for the combined workflow function and separate webhook function. Final GREEN requires building and importing real ESM bundles under Node.

All 11 frame, inline annotation, code-token, hint, note, help, and docs snapshot declarations are translated. The test model keeps styled fragments readable as HTML-like tags, matching the TypeScript mock rather than embedding terminal escape bytes.

All four public-name, hierarchy, hint framing, native cause identity, and name-guard declarations are translated. Final GREEN requires the JavaScript binding to preserve Error subclass and cause identity.
All four hierarchy, documentation, cause identity, and type-guard declarations are translated.
All five retry-gate declarations are translated, including the security-sensitive requirement that only an Error with literal boolean fatal=true is treated as terminal.
The package-local module-scope-state sweep is translated separately so running only the error test crate retains the original safety signal.
Both replay-signal declarations are translated. The planned guard must require both the public name and eventId, preventing an ordinary runtime error from being misclassified as replay divergence.
All six hierarchy, docs, cause identity, optional diagnostic context, property omission, and name-guard declarations are translated.
All six hierarchy, bare-title, hint framing, cause identity, name-guard, and fatal retry-short-circuit declarations are translated.

Both base-error declarations are translated, including the prior WorkflowError.is regression and stable documentation framing. Final GREEN requires the JavaScript binding to expose the correct native Error name and guard behavior.

All five provenance-field and UTC date-coercion declarations are translated. The expected-RED API keeps timezone-naive, timezone-aware, timestamp-object, and nullable behavior explicit before implementation.
All 24 key, value, batch, contextual-reserved-key, post-merge, and immutable-materialization declarations are mirrored. Pending Rustfmt, test, and Clippy confirmation.
Both prototype-key security declarations are mirrored. Rust maps treat __proto__ as data and typed deserialization rejects object-shaped values before materialization. Pending CI confirmation.

All numeric, flag, fallback, clamping, radix, warning-dedup behavior, event-limit, and process-environment declarations are mirrored. Process-global behavior is isolated in a child test process. Pending CI confirmation.
All four entity class, payload field, inherited-property, and sealed-noop declarations are mirrored. Pending CI confirmation.
All 11 token-retention, owner-message, cancellation-reason, stored-event, and backend-only noop declarations are translated before the event schema implementation is added.
All 11 version constants, minting, kill-switch, readable-ceiling, newer-world, and legacy declarations are mirrored. Pending CI confirmation.

All 12 protocol-constant, context, capability, unknown-field, persistence-stripping, and bounded-version declarations are covered by direct and differential Rust tests. Pending consolidated branch confirmation.

All three default, explicit override, and implicit process-environment declarations are translated. Final GREEN additionally requires an isolated JavaScript binding test for live process.env mutation.

All 23 GET/POST, content-length, compression, streaming, abort, timeout, socket-reset, cancellation, queueing, and keep-alive declarations are translated against the planned Rust client contract. Final GREEN requires the same assertions against real loopback sockets rather than only a scripted contract harness.

All 32 prefix, queue-name, payload-discriminator, binary step-input, unknown-field, and creator-environment declarations are translated against the current Rust protocol implementation. Pending Rustfmt, test, and Clippy confirmation.
All five namespace precedence, silent-success, debug-reporting, and always-visible enqueue-failure declarations are translated before recovery implementation.
All 11 request-boundary, outcome-variant, required-field, unknown-outcome, and aggregate declarations are translated. Pending Rustfmt, test, and Clippy confirmation.

All strict counter, exact summary, duplicate-ID, empty-result, and maximum-cardinality security cases are translated. The Rust test additionally proves diagnostics do not reflect a sensitive run ID. Pending CI confirmation.
The optional analytics page-metadata declaration is translated, including UTC coercion of both lookback-window timestamps.
All nine fixed-width ordering, round-trip, safe-integer, legacy-prefix, ULID separation, and timestamp-validation declarations are translated. Pending CI confirmation.

All contradictory-state, null-smuggling, unsafe-attempt, checked-next-attempt, and legacy compatibility fixtures are covered by direct and differential Rust tests. Pending consolidated branch confirmation.
